course: 1C:Enterprise 8 Programming — from foundations to professional development
title: Two calls become one: speed still needs measuring
goal: Choose a measurable operation and optimize without losing correctness or platform budgets.

prerequisites.text: Complete P1–P9. Distinguish a common-module function from its application caller; preserve your source and run a separate training infobase.

sections.title: The question we are checking
paragraphs: A batched query looks cheaper, but first establish that it returns the same requests. Then distinguish explicit call count from measured time. Zero milliseconds on a tiny set does not mean free execution.
Use a new training copy and invented records only. Predict first, then compare the observation; preserve existing functions, files, and records.

sections.title: Your copy and separate files
paragraphs: Continue your own P9 copy. Preserve a DT backup and previous sources, restore into a new empty infobase and verify the path. Do not load over your work.

УчебнаяНадёжность common module: Server and Server call enabled; Client, Global and Privileged disabled. Данные.bsl contains helpers and the function; Приложение.bsl contains the separate caller. Add only missing definitions and keep one copy of each helper.

НовыйНаборРегистров creates new training records owned by this experiment. Preserve the previous handler first. Remove only the added startup call after one run, so reopening does not create another set. Compare your own references rather than the screenshot’s UUIDs.

sections.title: Metrics answer a question
paragraphs: Form-open time, server calls, memory and query time are different metrics. Define measurement boundaries, volume and environment. “Feels faster” is not acceptance. Use a small synthetic benchmark and explicitly distinguish it from field latency.
Repeat module 7 query measurement on an unchanged own set. Separate explicit 2 → 1 call count from observed durations. Verify keys/values first; losing a row is not acceptable optimization.

sections.title: The complete function: what happens to the data
paragraphs: УчебнаяНадёжность common module: Server and Server call enabled; Client, Global, and Privileged disabled. Functions are outside procedures. The application module has one handler that calls the function and displays labelled result fields.
This is Данные.bsl for the common module. The separate application source below calls it. Do not paste both files into one editor.

sections.title: The application call and its observation
paragraphs: Read the same two 30/45 references individually and in one batch. Each path has five observations with alternating order. Check both references, two rows and 75 minutes. Explicit Выполнить calls are two versus one. Timings are separate and may tie; this is not an internal SQL count.
Each message is labelled: identical Да values concern different assertions. Find the expression behind each line and distinguish its truth from the fact that the program ran.

The caller below prints summary properties. The function also returns СырыеЗамеры: ten rows with order, call count and timing. The table records a separate actual BASIC run; the image shows the GUI summary. Zero readings reflect timer precision; no speed advantage is claimed.

sections.title: Profiles locate bottlenecks
paragraphs: Collect baseline, then identify dominant operations. Optimizing a negligible function may not affect users. Count calls and repeated computations. Avoid changing algorithm, data and UI at once; sequential changes identify causes and permit rollback.

Open Designer → Debug → Performance measurement, run the own scenario and stop afterwards. If unavailable in the edition/version, record that and use admitted explicit counters without claiming internal SQL measurements.

sections.title: Your prediction first
paragraphs: The batched path is faster but returns only one request. Can it be accepted?
Identify the changed action and what should remain unchanged. Reveal the explanation after making your own prediction.

reveal.title: Check the reasoning
paragraphs: No. Losing a reference violates the contract regardless of time. A matching total can hide a substituted row. Compare keys and values first, then one metric chosen in advance.

sections.title: Control comparison conditions
paragraphs: Use equal data/versions, repeated runs and an agreed cache policy. Check values before speed. Removing permission or preservation checks is not optimization. One local timing is not p95, and small-data success does not prove million-row scaling.

Interpret metrics separately: calls, own section time and inclusive duration answer different questions. Retain at least five equal-condition raw runs, volume, version, order and cache assumptions. Exclude license/user information from screenshots.

sections.title: Trace preservation step by step
paragraphs: Establish equivalent results before collecting observations. The raw table belongs to one actual training run; your timings may differ. This experiment changes no Nexus loading budget.
Read each arrow: what value or relation exists now, and which action changes it? The diagram explains the selected property rather than replacing the source.

sections.title: An error that can look successful
paragraphs: One run shows 0ms and is called server p95. There is no field workload, sufficient sample or precision for that conclusion. Raw 0/1ms values are facts about this small local experiment, not a speed guarantee.
Keep the faulty copy separate. To establish a fix, compare the relevant observation with your prior expectation; do not change an expectation merely to obtain a match.

sections.title: Budgets and rollback
paragraphs: Record budget, observed result and rejection conditions. Preserve regressions and return to the accepted version without deleting work. NEXUS-PERF-01 startup limits remain independent of teaching benchmarks. Test offline compression too: smaller files must preserve lesson access and progress.
Accept changes only with equivalent results and a predefined local budget. Keep the old version for rollback. This 1C investigation neither changes Nexus NEXUS-PERF-01 nor proves field p95.

sections.title: Now a new independent task
paragraphs: Use a new unchanged 20/60 set. Verify both exact references and 80 minutes for both paths. Save five raw observations per path and their execution order. Report two and one explicit calls separately from time. Do not claim speedup when timings tie or fluctuate.
The worked example addresses another question. Begin with this task’s starter and reveal the reference after your attempt. Viewing an example or reference does not replace your code.

paragraphs: УчебнаяНадёжность common module: Server and Server call enabled; Client, Global, and Privileged disabled. Functions are outside procedures. The application module has one handler that calls the function and displays labelled result fields.

Preserve the previous handler separately. Run the experiment once in your copy, compare labelled messages and specific new records, then remove only the added startup call. Do not delete records to match a screenshot.

sections.title: Limits of the observation and your explanation
paragraphs: Only the described training actions are established. Two concurrent sessions, clusters, field latency, debugger GUI and arbitrary external-code safety remain separate. Execution, a saved mark and learner understanding are distinct.
Separate call count, observed local time, timer precision and unmeasured field latency.

selfcheck.prompt: The batched path is faster but returns only one request. Can it be accepted?
options: Yes: timing matters more than membership
Yes: if the total happens to match
selfcheck.feedback: No. Losing a reference violates the contract regardless of time. A matching total can hide a substituted row. Compare keys and values first, then one metric chosen in advance.

selfcheck.prompt: May optimization remove permission checks for speed?
selfcheck.feedback: Correctness and security belong to the contract.
Do not broaden a metric without data.
A fast wrong answer is rejected.

selfcheck.prompt: Does a zero reading for one run establish zero query cost?
options: No: timer precision and conditions matter
selfcheck.feedback: Separate call count, observed local time, timer precision and unmeasured field latency.

selfcheck.prompt: Explain your own changed case: what stayed the same, what changed, and which fresh read demonstrates it?
selfcheck.feedback: The answer is not graded automatically. Compare the reasoning with concrete observations from your work.
